name: @shepherdjerred/charts
description: First-party Helm chart repository and read-only console UI

scripts.test: bun --no-install --bun vitest --config ../../vitest.config.ts run client && mise exec rust sccache -- cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.typecheck: PATH=node_modules/@typescript/native/bin:$PATH tsc --noEmit && mise exec rust sccache -- cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked
scripts.lint: bunx eslint --cache . --max-warnings=0 && mise exec rust sccache -- cargo fmt --all -- --check && mise exec rust sccache -- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
